name: Pyromancer: Inner Flame gives the party 3% crit (#3914)
contract: #3914: Inner Flame 301974 is a family 30 infinite passive whose e1 is SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID (65) with aura 290 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT), BasePoints 2 + DieSides 1 = 3, TargetA caster, radius 100 yd. Spell::EffectApplyAreaAura (SpellEffects.cpp:137) applies it to grouped players in range and AuraEffect::HandleAuraModCritPct (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:4890) raises spell crit (StatSystem.cpp:981). Asserts that a grouped second Pyromancer gains the aura 301974 and +3 Fire spell crit points, and that the caster gains +3 as well. The 'does not stack' rule (spell_group 2000181, pending SQL) is not asserted: no second raid crit aura id is recorded in the group report.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Put both Pyromancers in one party
The party member receives the area aura
The party member gains 3 Fire spell crit points
The caster gains 3 Fire spell crit points
Unlearning removes the party member's aura
The party member returns to the base crit chance
